blocks.tamil_translation: ﷺ said, narrates Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: يأَ أَبَا ذَرٍّ! إِنِّي أَرَاكَ ضَعِيفاً، وَإِنِّيْ أُحِبُّ لَكَ مَا أُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِي، لَا تَأَمَّرَنَّ عَلَي اثْنَيْنِ وَلَا تَوَلَّيَنَّ مَالَ يَتِيمٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب كراهة الامارة بغير ضرورة، رقم:٤٧٢٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates, “Rasulullah ﷺ said to me (to Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) in an affectionate manner), “O Abu Dharr, I consider you weak. (I consider that you are not able to fulfil the responsibility of an Amir.) I want for you what I want for myself. Do not become Amir even over two people, and do not accept becoming guardian of an orphan's property either.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- The meaning of what Rasulullah ﷺ said to Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) is: “If I were weak like you, I would never be Amir even over two people.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ﵁ قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! أَلَا تَسْتَعْمِلُنِي؟ قَالَ: فَضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ عَلَي مَنْكِبِي، ثُمَّ قَالَ: يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ إِنَّكَ ضَعِيفٌ، وَإِنَّهَا أَمَانَةٌ، وَإِنَّهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ خِزْيٌ وَنَدَامَةٌ، إِلَّا مَنْ أَخَذَهَا بِحَقِّهَا وَأَدَّي الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ فِيهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب كراهة الامارة بغير ضرورة، رقم: ٤٧١٩
blocks.tamil_translation: I asked the Prophet ﷺ, “O Rasulullah, why do you not appoint me as Amir?” The Prophet ﷺ, patting me on my shoulder with his hand, said, “O Abu Dharr, you are weak!” The responsibility of an Amir is a trust (amanah). (The rights of the servants are connected with it.)
